prompts.name: moss-slate
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production game sprite for Jump Royale, a beautiful moonlit forest platformer. High-fidelity 16-bit pixel art, fine intentional pixel clusters, rich hand-painted pixel shading, crisp texture detail, cohesive dark teal slate rock, jade moss and silvery blue moonlight. Orthographic SIDE VIEW, absolutely no perspective or isometric angle. One isolated long horizontal ledge, about 4:1 width to height. Level, continuous, straight walkable top edge with a thin luminous moss rim. Substantial solid rock immediately beneath the ENTIRE top. Organic fractured underside, tiny hanging roots. No grass or object sticking above the walkable line. Transparent background with real alpha, not checkerboard. Center asset with generous empty margins. No text, characters, watermarks or surrounding landscape. Base variant: ancient slate ledge with sumptuous moss cushions along the lip, beautiful layered slate fractures, subtle lichen, tiny turquoise crystals recessed into the rock face. Natural elegant believable terrain, not bricks.

prompts.name: water
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production 2D game environment water texture, beautiful moonlit forest river for a high-fidelity 16-bit pixel-art platformer. Wide 1536x1024 image filled edge-to-edge with water only. SIDE VIEW water body: a straight horizontal upper surface precisely along the top edge, rich rolling tiny silver-teal ripples and delicate foamy highlights concentrated in upper 15 percent, intricate layered translucent turquoise swirls below, grading smoothly into deep navy blue abyss in bottom half. Shimmering reflected moonlight is distributed across the width, no central spotlight. Premium hand-painted pixel clusters, sumptuous depth and readable glittering ripples. Cohesive jade, petrol blue, cyan and midnight indigo palette, not neon. Horizontally seamless texture with no objects at either edge. NO sky, no actual moon, no shoreline, no rocks, no plants, no horizon landscape, no characters, no text. Opaque water to all edges, no transparent margins.
